place_name: Coffee For Peace at One Oasis
review_text: After finding this place on Google maps we gave it a try on our way to the mall. Great drink menu, which is what we were after and many good looking choices. We tried a Sweet Coffee, Caramel Latte and a slice of their Pistachio Cheese Cake. All three were excellent and a great way to start our day. Friendly staff, nice environment and clean CR.

place_name: Coffee For Peace at One Oasis
review_text: Nice place to have some coffee and a quick snack/meal. And assorted beverage cold as well as hot. You will order in the counter and will be served afterward. They also sell jewelleries I like it very much.

place_name: Coffee For Peace at One Oasis
review_text: They have the rare Civet coffee along with all their beans are local to the area. The cafe is very calm and the service matches the quality of the beans. I am not surprised with all the awards. I recommend the sikwate. My suggestion to the establishment would be for some smaller breakfast dishes to balance the sweetness of the coffee.

place_name: Coffee For Peace at One Oasis
review_text: Wow..it's such a hidden gem in the not so busy street in Oasis area. The decors are classic and a good place for a good coffee. A bit costly but it's a place you want to go if you need some serious talks or simply enjoy the aroma of your favorite coffee.

place_name: Coffee For Peace at One Oasis
review_text: A lot of items in the menu are not available. Settled on a lemonade (the only one available from the 4 or 5 listed in the menu) and a pasta (only two choices left from the menu). Lemonade they served me barely tasted of lemons - twas more like water with a squeeze of a small lemon wedge. The pasta was awful, some of the noodles were not fully cooked, tasteless, seemed to be microwaved. I tried to tell the staff but she just stared at me 🤷 ♀️, no offer to rectify. Oh and i'm totally glad that I had presence of mind to ask how old was the cake they were selling. Staff said a week ago. Phew. Never going back, a lot of other, waaaay better cafe choices nearby.

place_name: Coffee For Peace at One Oasis
review_text: Very friendly owner and staff. Delicious cakes and muffins, and good coffee. Free wifi. Comfortable and cool cafe.

place_name: Coffee For Peace at One Oasis
review_text: Good advocacy. They really help various communities, especially our local coffee farmers who get paid 10 pesos per kilo from regular capitalistic companies. Good food and ambiance. If you are looking for local authentic coffee for your home, this is the place to buy it.

place_name: Coffee For Peace at One Oasis
review_text: The place is tiny but the ambiance is relaxed. I like the various beverages they offer. I think this is the FIRST and maybe ONLY coffee shop I tried that offers civet coffee that is worth recommending……Their tomato basil pasta is the one I usually order and their sandwiches. The parking is very limited to two slots. Prices are higher compared to other coffee shops though. It is better to visit during lean hours.

place_name: Coffee For Peace at One Oasis
